summary: A 19-second vertical black-and-white VHS-strobe promo for STROBFY. For 15 seconds it cuts hard every 3 frames (10 cuts a second), alternating found-image cards (a vintage panther poster, an 'IT IS / IS IT' type box and its inverse, an ink horse sketch, a blurred galloping white horse, a greyscale portrait poster with serif words, a moon close-up, and a pixel '1983 YMO JAPAN TOUR' card) with pure black frames, so the edit reads as a stroboscopic flicker. Almost every other shot is black; many shots carry datamosh glitch slicing and camcorder OSD overlays (PLAY ▶, « HI-FI », 'AM 1:40 OCT. 31 1985'). The cut rate never changes. At 15.0s it lands on a static 4-second end card: the horse darkened with a centred Instagram glyph and @STROBFY, over a single bass impact, then silence.
globals: Footer 'STROBFY.COM': tiny white bold grotesk caps (~1% of frame height), centred at x 50%, y 89%; black on light cards.

Instagram badge: small outline Instagram glyph (~2.5% of frame width) with '@STROBFY' in tiny caps below and a faint grey one-line photo credit under it; at x ~90%, y ~24% (top-right) from the start to about frame 267, sometimes tinted magenta, then at x ~9%, y ~61% (left side) from about frame 276 to the end card.
VHS texture over everything: sparse thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise, a light tape jitter on the edges, film grain; all monochrome.

cards.name: Panther poster
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Full-bleed crop of a vintage black-and-white circus/wrestling poster on off-white paper (#F2F2F0). Picture is scaled ~180% so everything bleeds off the edges: a black woodcut-style roaring panther head fills x 0-100%, y 15-75%, mouth open with mid-grey tongue. Top edge: a hand-brushed black display headline cropped to its last letters ('...HER'), cap height ~9% of frame height, y 2-12%, letters running off left and right. Bottom block y 78-95%: three lines of old-style serif (Century/Clarendon feel), black, sentence case, ~4.5% of frame height each, left-aligned and cropped off both sides. Static, no motion.

cards.name: Black beat
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Pure black frame (#000) carrying only the global elements (Instagram badge, footer, VHS streaks). Used between almost every image card as the 'off' half of the strobe. Often carries an OSD modifier (PLAY, HI-FI or the timestamp).

cards.name: IT IS box
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Black background. A centred light-grey (#E8E8E8) square with a fine halftone/dot texture, x 18-82%, y 30-68% (about 64% of frame width). Inside, a 2x2 grid of neo-grotesk (Helvetica/Neue Haas style) words, regular weight, uppercase, tight tracking, black, cap height ~10% of frame height: 'IT' top-left, 'IS' top-right, 'IS' bottom-left, 'IT' bottom-right, each word near its quadrant's outer corner with large gutters. Static.

cards.name: IT IS box inverted
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Exact inverse of C: off-white (#F2F2F0) background, black square with dot texture at x 18-82%, y 30-68%, words in light grey. Same 2x2 'IT IS / IS IT' grotesk layout. Static.

cards.name: Ink sketch
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Off-white background filled by a loose black brush/ink line drawing of a rearing horse and rider seen close-up (expressive dry-brush strokes, some grey dry-brush texture), occupying x 0-100%, y 0-100%, cropped at the edges. Hard threshold, pure black on white. Static.

cards.name: Galloping horse
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Black background, a white horse silhouette in mid-gallop facing left, photo crushed to near-threshold (pure white body, black ground) with heavy horizontal motion blur/smear on legs and tail; horse fills x 0-75%, y 15-75%, white streak flecks at the right edge (x 70-100%, y 20-35%). Static frame (the motion is baked into the blur).

cards.name: Galloping horse inverted
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Negative of G: off-white background with the horse silhouette in black, same crop and motion smear.

cards.name: Portrait poster
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Full-bleed greyscale photo of a young person from the chest up, facing camera with head slightly down, flat grey backdrop, low contrast, slight blur and grain, mid-grey overall (face at x 25-80%, y 10-60%). Overlaid black old-style serif words (condensed newspaper serif), sentence case, ~6% of frame height: 'Wet' at x 3%, y 22%; a circled numeral '4' at x 42%, y 25%; 'Don't' over 'January' at x 3%, y 42-50%; 'You' inside a hand-drawn black ellipse at x 55-75%, y 42%; '29,' at x 54%, y 50%; '2024' at x 78%, y 50%. Static.

cards.name: Portrait poster washed
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Variant of F with the photo lifted to a pale grey (low contrast, washed out) and the overlaid words turned white with a soft glow; same layout.

cards.name: Moon
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Black background; greyscale photo of the moon's cratered surface seen from close, a huge disc whose lower curved limb sits at y ~80% and which fills x 0-100%, y 0-80%; terminator shading darker at top. Static.

cards.name: Moon on white
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Same moon crop as H but the sky around the disc is white instead of black (background inverted while the moon stays positive).

cards.name: Pixel tour card
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Off-white background, mostly empty. Upper-right block x 40-100%, y 20-36%: four rows of chunky bitmap/pixel display type, black, uppercase, very wide tracking so each glyph sits in a column (4 columns), cap height ~3% of frame height, glyphs partly broken/eroded: '1 9 8 3' / 'Y M O' / 'J A P A N' / 'T O U R', running off the right edge. Static.

cards.name: Scribble box
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Black background; centred white box x 25-75%, y 32-68% containing a pixelated (nearest-neighbour upscaled, 1-bit) black ink scribble of a face/horse head. Always shown glitched (sliced, offset rows).

cards.name: White flash
cards.description: Global VHS treatment on every frame: thin horizontal white/grey dropout streaks and line noise scattered over the frame, slight tape jitter, fine grain; everything is monochrome. Blank off-white (#F2F2F0) frame with only the footer and badge; a one-shot white flash.

cards.name: End card
cards.description: Holds a still of G (galloping horse) darkened to ~25% brightness, with residual glitch block offsets frozen in place. Centred Instagram glyph (rounded square with circle and dot), white, ~10% of frame width, at x 50%, y 61%; below it '@STROBFY' in small white bold grotesk caps, ~1.4% of frame height, at y 66%. Footer 'STROBFY.COM' dimmed to dark grey. Fully static for 4 seconds; music impact plays at 15.37s and decays to silence by ~16.4s.

modifiers.description: Digital/VHS datamosh glitch: the image is cut into 3-8 horizontal bands that are offset sideways by 5-30% of frame width, with solid black (on light cards) or white rectangles 10-40% wide x 3-8% tall punched in, some rows smeared/stretched horizontally; text may be doubled or sliced mid-letter. Holds for the whole 3-frame shot (different random slicing per shot).

Camcorder timestamp OSD: two lines 'AM 1:40' / 'OCT. 31 1985' in white blocky VHS pixel font with slight bloom, cap height ~3.5% of frame height, left-aligned at x 32%, y 75% and y 81% (on some shots it sits at x 10%). Static.
VCR 'PLAY ▶' OSD: white pixel VHS font, uppercase, cap height ~3% of frame height, at x 7%, y 11% (top-left), with a little bloom. Static.
VCR '« HI-FI »' OSD: white pixel VHS font with double chevrons, cap height ~2.5% of frame height, centred around x 25-45%, y 7-12% (top). Static.
1-bit dither/halftone: the image is posterised to pure black and white with coarse error-diffusion noise, grain blowing out highlights (used on a moon and a portrait shot).

end: Holds a still of G (galloping horse) darkened to ~25% brightness, with residual glitch block offsets frozen in place. Centred Instagram glyph (rounded square with circle and dot), white, ~10% of frame width, at x 50%, y 61%; below it '@STROBFY' in small white bold grotesk caps, ~1.4% of frame height, at y 66%. Footer 'STROBFY.COM' dimmed to dark grey. Fully static for 4 seconds; music impact plays at 15.37s and decays to silence by ~16.4s.

sfx.kind: impact (sub-bass boom on the end card after a 0.5s silence, decays by ~16.4s)

audio.music: Driving dark electronic/industrial-techno loop at 120 BPM, high energy: heavy distorted kick, snappy snare and tight hi-hats, 16th-note percussive and glitch hits; hard-stops at 14.89s, then one bass impact. Audio ends at 17.18s, the last 1.8s are silent.
